name: Hybrid Login
description: Customizable login-page block plus form alters that present an external (SAML) login option alongside or instead of the Drupal login form.
project_description:
This module is designed to generate a custom login block for use on the Drupal user login page.

 Features 
 
 Show the Drupal default login, your external login service of choice, or both. 
 Add a title for the Hybrid Login block 
 Add a description to the Hybrid Login block, informing users how they can access their account using an external login service. 
 Deny/allow access to the password reset page 
 Add a description to the password reset page, informing users how they can reset their password on Drupal or selected login service 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Place the "Hybrid Login" block on the Block Layout page, located at Structure > Block layout 
 
 It is recommended to place the block in the "Content" region, above the "Main page content" and below the "Admin tabs", if applicable. 
 
 Configure the block with the recommended settings 
 
 Display title: Optional 
 Show for the listed pages: /user/login 
 
 Visit the admin settings page for Hybrid Login, located at Configuration > People > Login settings 
 
 /admin/config/people/hybrid_login 
 
 It is recommended to clear cache after changing any Hybrid Login settings. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This module was created around the SAML Authentication module , but allows configuration to work with other SAML modules.
